headline: US Approves SpaceX Plan for Orbital Data Centres
summary: SpaceX has received US approval to deploy solar-powered satellites in orbit to operate space-based data centers for AI applications.
why: Regulatory authorization for space-based computing infrastructure represents an emerging frontier in telecommunications and technology infrastructure investment.

impacts.name: SpaceX
impacts.why: Regulatory greenlight permits the deployment of orbital data center infrastructure.
